PluginDescription: UPnP/DLNA server and control point - yaiol fork with library filters as root containers
lblLibPthNameCollision: A path set with this name already exists.
ViewsBucketByLetterTip: Split the field value by their first letter
btnLibViwFilter: Show only the nodes following the selected template
chkEnableController: UPnP Control Point : Add network UPnP/DLNA renderers as MusicBee output devices
lblPbkContinuousStream: Enables gapless playback and cross-fading but output will lag and the device will not be able to show current track information
chkSrvEnableBrowse: UPnP Server: Enable UPnP devices to browse and play from the MusicBee library
chkDevEnableSoundEffects: Use the equaliser and DSP effects active in MusicBee   [forces transcoding]
chkDevEnableReplayGain: Level the playback volume using the replay gain mode active in MusicBee   [forces transcoding]
lblSrvSettings: Server settings for file streaming and library access:
MaxConnectionsTip: Maximum concurrent file streams the plugin will serve. Raise if a device that fires many parallel requests (some Marantz/Linn during artwork scans) saw a ⚠ Max Conn badge. Default 16, range 1-256. Changing this requires a MusicBee restart.
MaxConnectionsBadgeTip: The max-connections cap was reached at least once since MusicBee started. Consider raising "max concurrent connections" above and restarting MusicBee.
RestartRequiredBadgeTip: A setting you saved needs a MusicBee restart to take effect. Quit and reopen MusicBee for the changes to apply.
lblDevTranscoding: When transcoding the source file data:
txtDevUserAgent: enter the user-agent for the device
chkDevForceLittleEndianPcm: Force little endian for PCM streams
chkPbkForceNativeStreamForRadio: Force native stream for radio (bypass transcoder for stations)
chkDevEnableNextUri: Enable gapless playback (NextURI) for this device
chkDevDoNotClearNextUri: Do not send blank NextURI when queue empties
chkPbkBandwidthIsConstrained: Network is bandwidth constrained - transcode output to the lossy format set in the device profile above
chkDevForceTranscoding: Force transcoding (mutually exclusive with force native stream)
ConfirmSaveAmendments: One or more values have been amended - do you want to save the changes?
WarnIpAddressNotOperational: WARNING: The selected IP Address {0} is not currently operational
WarnPictureSize: WARNING: The DLNA standard size is 160px - not all rendering devices support larger pictures
WarnBandwidth: You need to select a lossy format in the transcoding section of the device profile in order for the amount of data transmitted to be reduced
WarnPortInUse: The configured network port {0} is not available (in use by another application, or reserved by Windows). MusicBee UPnP is now using port {1} instead. Devices will discover it automatically. To use a fixed port, choose a free one in the plugin settings.
chkEnableMediaRenderer: UPnP Renderer : Enable other apps to play to MusicBee
